title: Revising Himself: Walt Whitman and Leaves of Grass
excerpt: Whitman published the first edition of Leaves of Grass in 1855.
assertion: LOC documents successive authorial editions through the 1891-1892 deathbed edition and emphasizes changed contents and wording. The NLTK header's 1855 does not date the complete transcription.
